answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. A seat is earned, not claimed: Winebound grape fixer vine licence makes sure of that, since a licence grape fixers carry after wine cellar audits. Nobody is waved through free: 13 letters of reference, each one priced at £68 is the price, and the quill never covers it twice. Every oasis is counted once. The pearl is checked, not assumed.
